name: Frontend Developer
description: Builds UI components, handles styling, and implements responsive layouts.

name: Backend Engineer
description: Designs APIs, manages database schemas, and implements server-side logic.

name: QA Sentinel
description: Writes unit and integration tests and validates behavior.

name: Research Specialist
description: Web research and synthesis. Spawned by the CEO in team-mode to deepen spec docs and discover external APIs for the auto-spawn pipeline.

name: Solution Architect
description: Decomposes spec docs into module + interface boundaries. Spawned by the CEO in team-mode for non-trivial system design questions.

name: Product Lead
description: Frames goals, success metrics, and acceptance criteria from a user-value angle. Spawned by the CEO in team-mode while drafting the spec doc.

name: API Scout
description: Searches public APIs that match a requested capability. Output feeds the auto-spawn pipeline's `synthesizing-mcp` stage to generate a custom MCP server. Whitelist-aware.
